legal.over_quickie.meta_description: More about Quickie.nu as a platform: our role, and how we handle privacy, verification and safety.
legal.over_quickie.intro: Quickie.nu was founded on the belief that a modern classifieds platform should do more than just publish listings. That's why we're building a platform where privacy, safety and careful verification come first.
legal.over_quickie.role_p1: Quickie.nu connects visitors and independent advertisers. We are not an intermediary, an escort agency, or a party to any appointments, communication or payments between visitors and advertisers.
legal.over_quickie.role_p2: Every advertiser remains responsible for the content of their own listing and for complying with applicable laws and regulations.
legal.over_quickie.more_info_p: Want to know more about how we handle privacy, verification and safety? Also check out:
legal.verificatiebeleid.meta_description: How Quickie.nu verifies advertisers before a listing is published and reviewed.
legal.verificatiebeleid.intro: To safeguard the reliability of Quickie.nu, we verify every new advertiser before a listing can be published.
legal.verificatiebeleid.what_intro: During verification we check, among other things:
legal.verificatiebeleid.age_note: Although the national minimum age for prostitution is 18, our platform strictly requires 21. We apply this limit to every listing in every municipality to protect vulnerable people.
legal.verificatiebeleid.review_p: Once verification is successful, a listing can be submitted. Every listing is then manually reviewed before it's published.
legal.verificatiebeleid.no_guarantee_p1: Successful verification does not automatically mean a listing will be published.
legal.verificatiebeleid.no_guarantee_p2: If a listing doesn't meet our guidelines, or if we doubt the accuracy of the information provided, we may decide not to publish it or to remove it later.
legal.privacybeleid.meta_description: What personal data Quickie.nu processes, why, how long we keep it, and what rights you have.
legal.privacybeleid.privacy_p: Quickie.nu processes advertisers' personal data to offer, secure and manage the platform. We handle this data carefully and only process personal data necessary for these purposes.
legal.privacybeleid.what_data_intro: Depending on how you use our platform, we may process the following personal data:
legal.privacybeleid.h2_why: Why do we process this data?
legal.privacybeleid.why_intro: We process personal data, among other things, to:
legal.privacybeleid.h2_retention: How long do we keep data?
legal.privacybeleid.retention_p1: We do not keep personal data longer than necessary.
legal.privacybeleid.retention_p2: Data used for identity verification is kept for up to 12 months after an account is closed or the last listing is removed. After that, this data is permanently deleted.
legal.privacybeleid.sharing_p1: We do not sell personal data to third parties.
legal.privacybeleid.sharing_p2: Personal data is only shared when necessary for our services or when we are legally required to do so.
legal.privacybeleid.rights_p: You can contact us to view, correct or have your personal data deleted. You can also object to the processing of your personal data, insofar as the law allows.
legal.meldprocedure.meta_description: How to report a listing on Quickie.nu, and what we do with a report.
legal.meldprocedure.intro: Quickie.nu takes it seriously that listings comply with the law and our guidelines. Do you see a listing that you believe is incorrect, misleading or unlawful? You can easily report it.
legal.meldprocedure.report_p1: Every listing page has a "Report listing" button. The report form lets you indicate why you're reporting a listing and optionally add an explanation.
legal.meldprocedure.report_p2: Prefer to contact us by email instead? That's possible too, via [email address].
legal.meldprocedure.what_we_do_p1: Every report is reviewed by us.
legal.meldprocedure.what_we_do_p2: If a report turns out to be justified, we may, among other things:
legal.meldprocedure.action_request_info: Ask the advertiser for additional information
legal.meldprocedure.abuse_p: Reports must be made truthfully. In case of misuse of this reporting procedure, we may decide not to process a report any further.
legal.cookiebeleid.meta_description: Which cookies Quickie.nu uses and how you can remove or block them.
legal.cookiebeleid.cookies_p: Quickie.nu uses cookies to make the platform work properly and to improve the use of the website.
legal.cookiebeleid.cookie_necessary: Necessary cookies for the website to function.
legal.cookiebeleid.cookie_analytics: Analytical cookies to measure how the website is used.
legal.cookiebeleid.cookie_functional: Functional cookies to remember your preferences.
legal.cookiebeleid.consent_p: If we use other cookies that require consent, we ask for it in advance.
legal.cookiebeleid.delete_p: You can remove or block cookies at any time via your browser settings. Keep in mind that parts of the website may not work properly as a result.
legal.veilig_afspreken.meta_description: Tips to reduce the chance of unpleasant situations when arranging a meeting via Quickie.nu.
legal.veilig_afspreken.intro: Your safety always comes first. The tips below help reduce the chance of unpleasant situations.
legal.veilig_afspreken.check_listing_p: Read the listing carefully and check whether the information is clear and complete. Not sure about a listing? Report it using the "Report listing" button.
legal.veilig_afspreken.clear_agreements_: Agree in advance on which services are offered, what the costs are, and where the meeting will take place. This helps prevent misunderstandings.
legal.veilig_afspreken.no_unnecessary_da: Only share information needed to arrange a meeting. Be careful about sharing personal or financial details.
legal.veilig_afspreken.trust_gut_p: Does a situation not feel right, or does something change unexpectedly? Break off contact and don't go through with the meeting.
legal.veilig_afspreken.report_suspicious: Come across a listing that you believe is incorrect or possibly in violation of the law or our guidelines? Let us know using the "Report listing" button.
